<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$write-product-content</code></p>

Write or revise product documentation, release text, README copy, UI copy, or technical explanations for a real audience. Use when content must be concrete, evidence-backed, leak-free, and free of AI slop or process narration.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link write-product-content --scope user
arcantry skills link write-product-content --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link write-product-content --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Learning outcomes

- Turn authoritative product facts into concise audience-directed content.
- Remove unsupported claims, generic filler, repetition, and private context leakage.

## Examples

### Rewrite product documentation

**Prompt**

> Use $write-product-content to revise this documentation for developers while preserving its approved structure and presentation.

**Expected outcome**

The content leads with developer outcomes, uses verified commands, and removes process-centered filler.

### Prepare concise release copy

**Prompt**

> Use $write-product-content to turn these verified release facts into concise consumer-facing copy.

**Expected outcome**

The release text states concrete user impact without commit narration or unsupported significance.
